draft_en.subject: A second source for the media converters in the Canary range
draft_en.body:
Hi Charles,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 16 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the media converters in the Canary range (GT-55PD / GF-55 class), a second source alongside your current Taiwanese supplier, in Canary packaging from small lots, FCC/CE/RoHS: industrial Gigabit converter, 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP slot (fixed SC optional) - model STI-110GE - $26.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); PoE version - STI-111GP - $30.1; and an 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP unmanaged DIN switch - STI-280GE - $46.

One question: which converter model do your distributors reorder most - that is the one worth a side-by-side with the Volktek unit?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
